en: Vintage postcard showing an outdoor restaurant garden with round tables covered in white cloths under leafy trees. Waitresses in aprons and several guests pose for the camera; a man who appears to be the proprietor stands at right. The reverse has printed German and Hungarian text, including a caption naming the venue and street, the word for postcard in Hungarian, a vertical credit line, a Vienna address written in pencil, and a purple collector's stamp.
